description.zh: 理解集合通信语义、GPU 拓扑、带宽测量与故障定位，把一次通信基准转化为可信的性能分析。 每日补充图解、可运行CPU实验、预期输出、排错和解析题；保留真实框架选做路线。
description.en: Understand collectives, GPU topology, bandwidth measurements and diagnostics. Turn a communication benchmark into credible performance analysis. Every day includes diagrams, runnable CPU exercises, expected outputs, troubleshooting and explained quizzes, with an optional real-framework path.

title.zh: 先学会集合通信的语义

lesson.zh: AllReduce、AllGather 与 ReduceScatter 解决的是不同的数据分布问题。正确性取决于每个 rank 的输入、参与顺序、数据类型与期望输出，而不是只看最后有没有返回。NCCL 是 GPU 通信库，不能把 CPU 上的列表操作称为 NCCL 性能测试；但用小数据模拟能在接触硬件前暴露语义误解。
lesson.en: AllReduce, AllGather and ReduceScatter solve different data-distribution problems. Correctness depends on each rank’s input, call order, data type and expected output, not merely a successful return. NCCL is a GPU communication library. CPU list operations are not an NCCL performance test, but small semantic simulations reveal misunderstandings before hardware enters the picture.

lesson.zh: rank 是通信域中的逻辑编号，不自动等同于节点编号或物理 GPU 编号。应用必须明确每个进程使用哪张设备、哪些进程属于同一通信域，以及如何建立连接。错误的映射可能造成重复使用设备或等待不存在的参与者。环境记录应把进程、节点、设备和软件版本同时呈现。
lesson.en: A rank is a logical index within a communicator, not automatically a node number or physical GPU number. Applications must map processes to devices, define communicator membership and establish connections. Incorrect mapping can reuse a device unintentionally or wait for an absent participant. Document processes, nodes, devices and software versions together.

title.en: Read GPU topology and transport paths

lesson.zh: 同样的 GPU 数量可以对应不同的连接结构。PCIe、NVLink 和跨节点网络影响数据经过的路径，但单张拓扑图不能直接预测所有负载的吞吐。NUMA 位置、GPU 与网卡亲和性也可能影响观察。先把可达性和路径结构画清楚，再提出需要测量的假设。
lesson.en: The same GPU count can hide very different connectivity. PCIe, NVLink and inter-node networking shape transport paths, but one topology diagram cannot predict every workload’s throughput. NUMA placement and GPU–NIC affinity may matter as well. Establish reachability and structure first, then formulate hypotheses that measurement can test.

body.zh: 100MB按十进制是100,000,000字节。理想25/50/100 GB/s链路仅传输序列化成本分别4/2/1ms；这里没有计入启动、争用和多跳路由。不要把GB/s与Gb/s混用。
body.en: Decimal100MB is100,000,000 bytes. At25/50/100GB/s, ideal serialization takes4/2/1ms, excluding startup, contention and routing. GB/s and Gb/s differ by eight.

body.zh: 同节点GPU可能经过NVLink或PCIe，跨节点还涉及网卡与交换网络。名义链路规格不是某次collective能达到的速度；真实实验先保存拓扑，再比较相同消息和rank布局。
body.en: Local GPUs may use NVLink or PCIe; cross-node paths add NICs and switches. Nominal link speed is not achieved collective throughput. Save topology before comparing the same message and rank layout.

title.zh: 区分算法带宽与总线带宽

lesson.zh: 带宽指标只有在公式和单位明确时才有意义。alg bandwidth 由操作大小与耗时得到，而 bus bandwidth 使用操作相关的换算来估计链路工作量；它不等于某一根线缆的直接测速。比较不同 rank 数量时，必须同时说明操作类型和换算方式，否则看似相同的数字可能代表不同的传输量。
lesson.en: Bandwidth is meaningful only with explicit formulas and units. Algorithm bandwidth relates operation size to elapsed time; bus bandwidth applies a collective-specific conversion to estimate communication work. It is not a direct measurement of one physical cable. Comparisons across rank counts must include the operation and conversion, since equal-looking numbers can represent different transfer work.

body.en: NCCL-tests normalizes AllReduce as busbw=algbw×2(p−1)/p. Four ranks give factor1.5, hence15GB/s; two ranks give factor1. This is a convention conversion, not another faster network measurement.

The highest bandwidth point is not a representative summary of the entire system.

title.zh: 通信与计算的时间关系

lesson.zh: 把操作提交到 CUDA stream 并不意味着它已经完成。通信与计算能否重叠，取决于依赖、提交顺序以及资源竞争；更多 stream 不保证更快。group calls 可以组织多个通信调用，也需要理解当前版本的语义。先画出依赖图，再用时间线验证“重叠”是否真的减少端到端耗时。
lesson.en: Submitting work to a CUDA stream does not mean it has completed. Communication–compute overlap depends on dependencies, submission order and resource contention; more streams do not guarantee better performance. Group calls organize communication operations but have semantics that must match your version. Draw dependencies first, then use a timeline to test whether overlap reduces end-to-end time.

lesson.zh: 数据并行的梯度同步、张量并行的层内通信和缓存数据传输不一定使用相同模式。微基准能帮助定位通信上限，却不能代替真实模型的端到端评估。框架可能选择不同后端或把多个张量分桶；因此应从调用语义与数据量建立解释，而不是只给系统贴“网络慢”的标签。
lesson.en: Gradient synchronization in data parallelism, layer communication in tensor parallelism and cache transfers need not use the same pattern. Microbenchmarks help characterize communication limits but do not replace model-level evaluation. Frameworks may choose backends or bucket tensors differently. Explain semantics and data volume rather than labeling every slowdown as a network problem.

Change one understood setting at a time, preserve before/after evidence and keep experiments within your authorized lab environment.

title.zh: 完成一份可信的通信性能报告

lesson.zh: 性能报告的价值来自可复算与可质疑。结论应限定在已记录的拓扑、设备数量、软件版本、消息区间和负载条件下。给出原始数据、计算公式和重复运行范围，让别人能够验证你的解释。没有多卡设备也可以提交完整的语义实现与实验设计，但它和硬件性能报告是不同的成果类型。
lesson.en: A performance report is valuable when its calculations and conclusions can be questioned and reproduced. Limit claims to the recorded topology, device count, software versions, message range and workload. Include raw data, formulas and repeated-run ranges. Without multiple GPUs, a semantic implementation and experiment design are valid deliverables, but they are different from hardware measurements.
